title: Google’s Gemini Agent: How One Universal Tool Changes Your Daily Workflow
description:
Google is merging its AI tools into a single, universal work assistant, while OpenAI projects massive revenue growth. We’ll break down what these shifts mean for your daily desk work and the sustainability of the AI boom.

What we covered:
• Google Cloud unveils Gemini agent as a universal work assistant
• OpenAI Projects $70 Billion Annualized Revenue by End of 2026
• Anthropic launches the Cyber Mission with a critical infrastructure defense program and free OSS scanner

Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways.

Listener question: Would you trust an AI agent to manage your work calendar and email if it meant a 20% boost in your productivity?

What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules.

Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next.
